original_probe_comparison_mismatches.check: full-turn stream equals final non-tool message only

scope_and_checks.matrix: Production DmxNativeModel streaming parser, complete native tool call and ToolMessage continuation; a random marker is generated only after the first tool call. All supported distinct ModelSelection.parameters payloads are tested; exact aliases are deduplicated.
scope_and_checks.summary_programmatic: Production SummaryModel with public SummarizationMiddleware.before_model, trim_tokens_to_summarize=None, a retained current HumanMessage, nonempty no-tool output, and current input preservation.
scope_and_checks.summary_semantic_review: Parent agent separately read all five generated summaries: allowed temperature, excluded pressure, no user confirmation, and no execution are preserved; no new authorization was introduced. This is a manual content review, distinct from parser assertions.
scope_and_checks.help: Actual ReactAgent, current application state, original random session marker, full current model ID, commands /help /model /resume, streamed/final text equality, and local selection HTTP count. Thinking states were manually checked against actual parameters, including CDX low application default.
scope_and_checks.graph_tool_addendum: Added because the native matrix does not attach application_help, while initial real-agent help turns call no tools. Each fresh real graph now calls get_plant_info once; a synthetic override creates a new marker without loading configuration. Assertions verify one complete canonical tool group, tool receipt before the application_help tail, marker/model recovery, and no pending preparation or result.
scope_and_checks.stream_comparison_resolution: The original Flash graph sample failed an additional comparison of all on_text output against only the final non-tool AIMessage. The application streams text from tool-call messages too. A local two-newline tool-prefix fixture proves these quantities may legitimately differ. The original sample did not retain its streamed text, so its exact difference is not reconstructed. One authorized Flash live followup retains only public text and validates full stream against all canonical AIMessage.text, and final output against non-tool AIMessage.text; no raw reasoning is retained.
scope_and_checks.data_boundary: Only handwritten synthetic inputs, random markers, and ordinary application/tool contract text were transmitted. Domain overrides prevent configuration reads and physical execution; no raw requests/responses, reasoning, headers, or credentials are retained.
scope_and_checks.authorization: Network escalations for the scoped LC7 acceptance were approved; no denied action was bypassed.

limits: Sixty-two successful HTTP exchanges validate these samples, not long-term provider stability or maximum context capacity.
Response-declared model aliases are recorded, not independently authenticated backend identities.
No all-Responses migration was tested; existing Chat/Responses mappings remain in force.
Small synthetic summary and conversation checks are not an exhaustive language-fidelity evaluation or physical/site validation.
Usage and latency are safe per-case observations, not a complete cost total or performance benchmark.

source_evidence.working_tree: uncommitted LC1-LC7 implementation; file hashes identify the inspected production files
source_evidence.temporary_file_retention: Probe sources are temporary and may be cleaned; this JSON retains safe results and hashes, not a permanent rerun entry point.
